_why: Every secret a workflow reads, with what it is for, when it stops working and how to replace it. The dates here are only a fallback: tools/check-credentials.mjs tries each secret against its own service every morning in radar.yml, and the radar shows what failed, what is missing and the expiry each service reports. test/workflows.test.js fails when a workflow reads a secret that is not listed here, or when this file lists one nothing reads, and test/credentials-check.test.js fails when a listed secret has no check. A secret marked optional is one the job that reads it can do without: it says so and skips, and the radar lists it as a decision rather than as something broken. Personal access tokens are refused outright: they expire and carry the whole account. On 2026-09-15 the personal token the catalog bot pushed with ran out.

BING_API_KEY.what: Bing Webmaster API key for the weekly search report (seo.yml)
BING_API_KEY.rotate: Bing Webmaster Tools, Settings, API access: generate a new key, then gh secret set BING_API_KEY

GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.what: Search Console service account key for the weekly search report (seo.yml)
GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.rotate: Google Cloud console, the service account, Keys: add a JSON key, delete the old one, then gh secret set GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON

YANDEX_OAUTH_TOKEN.what: Yandex Webmaster OAuth token for the weekly search report (seo.yml)
YANDEX_OAUTH_TOKEN.expiresNote: Yandex OAuth tokens last about a year; this one was set on 2026-08-15
YANDEX_OAUTH_TOKEN.rotate: oauth.yandex.com, the app: issue a new token, then gh secret set YANDEX_OAUTH_TOKEN

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.what: Deploys the site to Cloudflare Pages (site.yml) and purges replaced mirror files from the cache (r2.yml). Needs two permissions: Account, Cloudflare Pages, Edit and Zone, Cache Purge, Purge on dota2modmanager.com
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.rotate: Cloudflare dashboard, My Profile, API Tokens: roll the token, then gh secret set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.what: Which Cloudflare account the site deploys into (site.yml)
CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.rotate: Not a credential, but the site deploy needs it: Cloudflare dashboard, Account home, Account ID, then gh secret set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.what: The Cloudflare account that holds the mirror bucket (r2.yml, release.yml)
R2_ACCOUNT_ID.rotate: Not a credential, but the R2 check needs it: Cloudflare dashboard, R2, Account details, Account ID, then gh secret set R2_ACCOUNT_ID

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.what: R2 API key id for the mod and update mirror (r2.yml, release.yml)
R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.rotate: Cloudflare dashboard, R2, Manage API tokens: create a token for the bucket, then set R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID and R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY together

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.what: R2 API secret for the mod and update mirror (r2.yml, release.yml)

MIRROR_PUSH_URL.what: GitLab project access token inside the push URL of the code mirror (mirror.yml)
MIRROR_PUSH_URL.expiresNote: GitLab's longest allowed lifetime, set on 2026-09-09
MIRROR_PUSH_URL.rotate: gitlab.com, the project, Settings, Access tokens: a Maintainer token with write_repository, then gh secret set MIRROR_PUSH_URL with https://oauth2:<token>@gitlab.com/TheFleece/dota2-mod-manager.git

DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL.what: Posts each release to the public Discord channel (release.yml)
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL.rotate: Discord, the channel, Integrations, Webhooks: new webhook, delete the old one, then gh secret set DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL

RADAR_DISCORD_WEBHOOK.what: Sends the maintainer the radar's alerts, in a private Discord channel (radar.yml)
RADAR_DISCORD_WEBHOOK.rotate: Discord, the private channel, Integrations, Webhooks: new webhook, then gh secret set RADAR_DISCORD_WEBHOOK

FINGERPRINTS_DEPLOY_KEY.what: Deploy key the catalog bot pushes fingerprints and hero pages with (fingerprints.yml). It can write to this repository only, and it is on the main ruleset's bypass list
FINGERPRINTS_DEPLOY_KEY.rotate: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N "" -C fingerprints-bot -f fingerprints_bot, then gh repo deploy-key add fingerprints_bot.pub --allow-write --title "fingerprints bot", then gh secret set FINGERPRINTS_DEPLOY_KEY < fingerprints_bot, delete both local files and the old key

VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY.what: VirusTotal public API key: virustotal.yml reads the engines on each published installer and writes the report into the release notes
VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY.rotate: virustotal.com, the account menu, API key: copy it, then gh secret set VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY

STATS_APP_TOKEN.what: The catalog download counter's app token: release.yml writes it into the build (tools/stats-token.mjs), so installs from the catalog add to each mod's download count
STATS_APP_TOKEN.rotate: Ask the catalog's author for the new token (the Worker's APP_TOKEN, set with wrangler secret put APP_TOKEN), then gh secret set STATS_APP_TOKEN
